notes.title: Dark Rising Patch 102
notes.notes:
A new patch for Dark Rising has been released. This is a very small patch that adds a few tweaks and a new building.

[New]	Pledges gain experience points when killing zombies
[New]	Fountain of health (building that slowly heals pledges)

[Bug]	Javelin throwers not working
[Bug]	Net throwers not working correctly
[Bug] 	Some levels would stop producing enemies and cause the game to stop progressing

notes.title: Dark Rising Patch 101
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm happy to announce the first patch for Dark Rising has been released. This patch fixes quite a few small bugs and a few larger ones that were affecting gameplay. Below is a list of changes, fixes, and tweaks that come with the latest update:

[New]	Added a stand ground stance to keep pledges from wandering off
[New]	Volume sliders for music and master sound

[Tweak]	Improved single clicking to select units
[Tweak]	Nighttime and overall brightness has been increased
[Tweak]	You can now train pledges and build your village in the first level
[Tweak]	Achievements have been slightly rebalanced
[Tweak]	Swamp Level 01 has one less round
[Tweak]	Spiders give more gold when killed
[Tweak]	Zombies are more resistant to arrow fire

[Bug]	Enemy would stop spawning in Skylands Level 02
[Bug]	Adding spikes to a castle would cause pathfinding problems
[Bug]	When placing a building and switching the type of building, the player would lose the ablity to select and control units.
[Bug]	When offline, score would not be displayed correctly after level
[Bug]	Shadows would move in the wrong direction at mid-day
[Bug]	Tower flames were not always appearing on damaged tower
[Bug]	Tower collapse animation missing
[Bug]	Stone castle preview had front garrison slots facing wrong direction
[Bug]	Royal castle glitches (rotation error)
[Bug]	Can't select stone castle ingame
[Bug]	Skylands 01 chapel gather path is not visible

Upcoming Content
 Although Dark Rising has been released, I still want to keep updating the game and adding some new content. In the near future I'll be adding:


Pledges gain experience points when killing zombies
New enemy type that is especially good at destroying towers
Fountain of health (building that slowly heals pledges)
 

So stay tuned and expect some new content coming up soon.

notes.title: 20th of Ocotober, new Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Dark Rising's release date will be pushed back from the 13th to the 20th of October. The reason behind this decision is to deliver a game that is as bug free and polished as possible. During the next week I'll be play testing to make sure all the current features are as smooth as possible.

Thanks for understanding and see you guys on the 20th for some good old fashioned zombie killing. If you haven't already, please add Dark Rising to your "wishlist" or follow the game to keep up with all the updates.

-Joshua
